rule: Take the single ready item. One item per run. Mark it done only when its acceptance checks pass. Do not open the next item in the same run. Do not add rooms, marketplace dashboards, live retailer publish, MES, or a one-click legal pass.

items.title: Brand and mill share one case: brief, cloth, ask, answer, lock
acceptance: Source cites cloth and does not create a mill request, confirmation, or lock
Named colour is MUST; open colour does not invent navy
Mill view of the request has no brand id
Lock is refused until the mill answers, and refused when the mill marks the cloth unavailable

items.title: Factory Book accepts the mill's own xlsx or csv, not only the built-in pilot workbook
acceptance: A mill can drop a file on Factory → Book and see mapped columns plus searchable quality count
Unknown headers stay exceptions until someone confirms them
Brand → Find cloth searches that deposit
MOQ written in the file stays historical until the mill answers a request

items.title: An open demo case reloads after the server process restarts
acceptance: After source → ask, a fresh process still shows the open anonymous request
Lock still requires the stored mill confirmation
Brand identity still does not appear on the mill request
